title: FREE REQUEST In need of beta testers for my already released game.

posts.author: Benja
posts.body:
Hello!
A while ago I published my first commercial game,
Bubbaruka
. It got pretty good reception, but one common complaint is the glitches and bugs. Mind you, I have played this game over and over and over again, yet there still seems to be bugs that i just dont do the right things to find.
I want to make this game as bug free as possible, and I'm looking for beta testers to play through the game and report every encountered bug. I will give all beta testers copies of the game for free.
If anyone is interested in this, please reach out!
Engine: RPG Maker VX Ace
Synopsis:  A horror puzzle game about exploring an abandoned children's toy, stalked by the shambling husks of scrapped concepts that pursue you endlessly throughout the environment as you try to solve the cryptic puzzles left behind by the developers and keep your pet alive.
Positions Needed: Beta testers! I need Beta Testers to iron out the bugs in my already finished game.
Tags: Survival Horror, Puzzle, Mystery

posts.author: VOCALKENNI
posts.body: I'd be interested in helping out with beta testing if you'd like! <3

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
That's not what beta testing means. The word "beta" is a part of the standard versioning terminology that we use when developing software.
Alpha testing is done in the earliest stages of a piece of software, before it's feature complete.
Beta testing is done when the software is considered feature complete, before it's released.
Doing it three years
after
the software was released (i.e. version 1.0)...is something else
Anyway, I hope you have a collection of bug reports to give to your fixers for them to try to duplicate for you. Good luck with your project.
